hooks.command: if printf '%s' "$(cat)" | grep -Eq 'git commit[^|;&]*(--no-verify|[[:space:]]-[a-zA-Z]*n)'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit blocked: --no-verify would skip the .env pre-commit hook."}}'; elif git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '(^|/)\.env(\.[^/]+)?$' | grep -Evq '(^|/)\.env\.example$'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit blocked: staged changes include a .env file (only .env.example is allowed). Unstage it before committing."}}'; fi
